questions.text: Simplify: (2/3) + (1/6)
questions.explanation: Using a common denominator of 6: (2/3 = 4/6) + (1/6) = 5/6.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find x if 8x + 3 = 5x + 21
questions.explanation: 8x + 3 = 5x + 21, so 3x = 18, giving x = 6.

questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: The average of 8 numbers is 12. What is their sum?
questions.explanation: Sum = average x count = 12 x 8 = 96.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Solve: x^2 - 25 = 0
questions.explanation: x^2 = 25, so x = sqrt(25) = +-5, giving x = 5 or x = -5.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: If the ratio of boys to girls in a class is 3:4 and there are 15 boys, how many girls are there?
questions.explanation: 3 parts = 15, so 1 part = 5. Girls = 4 parts = 4 x 5 = 20.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the perimeter of a square with side length 11cm?
questions.explanation: Perimeter of a square = 4 x side = 4 x 11 = 44cm.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the area of a circle with radius 7cm? (Use pi = 22/7)

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Simplify: 2^3 x 2^4
questions.explanation: When multiplying powers with the same base, add the exponents: 2^3 x 2^4 = 2^7 = 128.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the value of the square root of 196?
questions.explanation: The square root of 196 is 14, since 14 x 14 = 196.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A motorist travels 150km in 2.5 hours. What is their average speed?
questions.explanation: Average speed = distance/time = 150/2.5 = 60 km/h.

questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the sum of the interior angles of a heptagon (7 sides)?
questions.explanation: The sum of interior angles of a polygon = (n-2) x 180, so for a heptagon (n=7): (7-2) x 180 = 900 degrees.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the sum of the interior angles of an octagon (8 sides)?
questions.explanation: Using (n-2) x 180 for an octagon (n=8): (8-2) x 180 = 1080 degrees.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Factorise: x^2 - 9x + 20
questions.explanation: We need two numbers that multiply to 20 and add to -9: -4 and -5. So x^2-9x+20 = (x-4)(x-5).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is 0.75 expressed as a fraction in its lowest terms?
questions.explanation: 0.75 = 75/100, which simplifies to 3/4 when divided by 25.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: If a = 6 and b = -4, find the value of a^2 - b^2

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the median of the data set: 5, 9, 11, 14, 22?
questions.explanation: With 5 values arranged in order (5,9,11,14,22), the median is the middle value: 11.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the mode of the data set: 2, 4, 4, 7, 9, 4, 10?
questions.explanation: The mode is the most frequently occurring value; 4 appears three times, more than any other value.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Convert 7/8 to a percentage.
questions.explanation: 7/8 = 0.875, which as a percentage is 87.5%.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the LCM (Lowest Common Multiple) of 4 and 10?
questions.explanation: Multiples of 4: 4,8,12,16,20...; multiples of 10: 10,20...; the smallest common multiple is 20.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the HCF (Highest Common Factor) of 24 and 36?
questions.explanation: The factors of 24 are 1,2,3,4,6,8,12,24; factors of 36 are 1,2,3,4,6,9,12,18,36; the highest common factor is 12.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: If 2x + 3y = 22 and x = 5, find the value of y.
questions.explanation: Substituting x=5: 2(5) + 3y = 22, so 10 + 3y = 22, giving 3y = 12, so y = 4.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A trader sells an item for N7,200 after a 10% discount on the original price. What was the original price?
questions.explanation: If N7,200 represents 90% of the original price, then original price = 7,200/0.9 = N8,000.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the next number in the sequence: 2, 6, 18, 54, ___?
questions.explanation: Each term is multiplied by 3 to get the next term: 54 x 3 = 162.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Simplify: (3a^2b) x (3ab^2)
questions.explanation: Multiplying coefficients: 3x3=9. Multiplying a terms: a^2 x a = a^3. Multiplying b terms: b x b^2 = b^3. Result: 9a^3b^3.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the value of x in the equation: 3(x - 2) = 2(x + 4)

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A rectangular plot has an area of 168 square metres and a width of 12 metres. What is its length?
questions.explanation: Length = Area/Width = 168/12 = 14 metres.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the probability of picking a green marble from a bag containing 5 green and 7 yellow marbles?
questions.explanation: Total marbles = 5 + 7 = 12. Probability of green = 5/12.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Express 3.6 x 10^3 as an ordinary number.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Simplify: 2^5 / 2^2
questions.explanation: When dividing powers with the same base, subtract the exponents: 2^5 / 2^2 = 2^3 = 8.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Evaluate: 5^0 + 3^0
questions.explanation: Any non-zero number raised to the power 0 equals 1, so 5^0 + 3^0 = 1 + 1 = 2.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Simplify: (x^3)^2
questions.explanation: When raising a power to a power, multiply the exponents: (x^3)^2 = x^(3x2) = x^6.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Evaluate: the square root of 16
questions.explanation: The square root of 16 is 4, since 4 x 4 = 16.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Evaluate: the cube root of 27
questions.explanation: The cube root of 27 is 3, since 3 x 3 x 3 = 27.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Evaluate: 2^3 x 2^-1
questions.explanation: When multiplying powers with the same base, add the exponents: 2^3 x 2^-1 = 2^2 = 4.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Simplify: a^5 / a^2
questions.explanation: When dividing powers with the same base, subtract the exponents: a^5 / a^2 = a^3.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Add in base 2: 101 + 011
questions.explanation: 101 (base 2) = 5 and 011 (base 2) = 3 in base 10; 5 + 3 = 8, which is written as 1000 in base 2.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Expand: (x + 3)(x - 3)
questions.explanation: This is a difference of two squares: (x+3)(x-3) = x^2 - 9.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Factorise: x^2 + 7x + 10
questions.explanation: We need two numbers that multiply to 10 and add to 7: 2 and 5, so x^2+7x+10 = (x+2)(x+5).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Solve simultaneously: x + y = 10, x - y = 4
questions.explanation: Adding both equations: 2x = 14, so x = 7. Substituting into x+y=10 gives y = 3.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Solve for x: (2x + 1)/3 = 5
questions.explanation: Multiplying both sides by 3: 2x + 1 = 15, so 2x = 14, giving x = 7.

questions.explanation: Multiplying coefficients: 2x3=6. Multiplying x terms: x^2 x x = x^3. Multiplying y terms: y x y^2 = y^3. Result: 6x^3y^3.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Solve the inequality: 3x - 2 > 7
questions.explanation: 3x - 2 > 7 gives 3x > 9, so x > 3.

questions.explanation: 4x - 4 = 2x + 10 gives 2x = 14, so x = 7.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: If 3x - y = 11 and y = 4, find the value of x.
questions.explanation: Substituting y=4: 3x - 4 = 11, so 3x = 15, giving x = 5.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the 10th term of the arithmetic progression: 3, 7, 11, 15, ...
questions.explanation: First term a=3, common difference d=4. T10 = a + 9d = 3 + 36 = 39.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the sum of the first 10 terms of the arithmetic progression: 2, 4, 6, 8, ...

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the nth term formula for the arithmetic progression: 5, 8, 11, 14, ...

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the 6th term of the geometric progression: 3, 6, 12, 24, ...

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the sum of the first 5 terms of the geometric progression: 2, 6, 18, 54, ...

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the common difference of the arithmetic progression: 15, 11, 7, 3, ...
questions.explanation: Each term decreases by 4 from the one before it (11-15=-4), so the common difference is -4.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: If the nth term of a sequence is given by Tn = 2n^2 - 1, find the 4th term.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the sum of the first 20 natural numbers (1 to 20).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: An arithmetic progression has first term 4 and common difference 3. Find its 15th term.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find x if 3, x, 11 are three consecutive terms of an arithmetic progression.
questions.explanation: In an AP, the middle term equals the average of its neighbours: x = (3 + 11)/2 = 7.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the volume of a cuboid with dimensions 5cm x 4cm x 3cm.
questions.explanation: Volume of a cuboid = length x width x height = 5 x 4 x 3 = 60 cm^3.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the volume of a cube of side 6cm.
questions.explanation: Volume of a cube = side^3 = 6^3 = 216 cm^3.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the circumference of a circle of radius 14cm. (Use pi = 22/7)
questions.explanation: Circumference = 2 x pi x r = 2 x (22/7) x 14 = 2 x 22 x 2 = 88 cm.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the area of a triangle with base 10cm and height 6cm.
questions.explanation: Area of a triangle = 1/2 x base x height = 1/2 x 10 x 6 = 30 cm^2.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the volume of a cylinder with radius 7cm and height 10cm. (Use pi = 22/7)

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the surface area of a cube of side 4cm.
questions.explanation: Surface area of a cube = 6 x side^2 = 6 x 16 = 96 cm^2.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the area of a trapezium with parallel sides 8cm and 12cm and height 5cm.
questions.explanation: Area = 1/2 x (sum of parallel sides) x height = 1/2 x 20 x 5 = 50 cm^2.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the perimeter of a rectangle with length 15cm and width 9cm.
questions.explanation: Perimeter = 2(length + width) = 2(15 + 9) = 48 cm.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the area of a rhombus with diagonals 10cm and 12cm.
questions.explanation: Area of a rhombus = 1/2 x d1 x d2 = 1/2 x 10 x 12 = 60 cm^2.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the volume of a cone with radius 3cm and height 7cm. (Use pi = 22/7)

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the total surface area of a cylinder with radius 7cm and height 10cm. (Use pi = 22/7)

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the area of a sector of a circle with radius 7cm and angle 90 degrees. (Use pi = 22/7)

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the length of an arc with radius 21cm and angle 60 degrees. (Use pi = 22/7)
questions.explanation: Arc length = (theta/360) x 2 x pi x r = (60/360) x 2 x (22/7) x 21 = (1/6) x 132 = 22 cm.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the area of a square whose diagonal is 8 x sqrt(2) cm.
questions.explanation: For a square, diagonal = side x sqrt(2), so side = 8cm. Area = side^2 = 64 cm^2.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A cuboid tank has length 4m, width 3m, and height 2m. Find its capacity in litres. (1 m^3 = 1000 litres)
questions.explanation: Volume = 4 x 3 x 2 = 24 m^3 = 24 x 1000 = 24,000 litres.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Two angles on a straight line are x and (3x + 40) degrees. Find x.
questions.explanation: Angles on a straight line sum to 180: x + 3x + 40 = 180, so 4x = 140, giving x = 35.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: In a triangle, the angles are x, 2x, and 3x. Find the value of x.
questions.explanation: The angles of a triangle sum to 180: x + 2x + 3x = 180, so 6x = 180, giving x = 30.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the sum of the interior angles of a pentagon (5 sides).
questions.explanation: Sum of interior angles = (n-2) x 180. For a pentagon (n=5): (5-2) x 180 = 540 degrees.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. If one co-interior angle is 65 degrees, find the other.
questions.explanation: Co-interior (allied) angles between parallel lines are supplementary, so the other angle = 180 - 65 = 115 degrees.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the value of each exterior angle of a regular hexagon.
questions.explanation: Exterior angles of a regular polygon sum to 360 degrees, so for a hexagon (6 sides): 360/6 = 60 degrees.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the value of each interior angle of a regular octagon.
questions.explanation: Sum of interior angles = (8-2) x 180 = 1080 degrees. Each angle = 1080/8 = 135 degrees.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: In triangle ABC, angle A = 50 degrees and angle B = 70 degrees. Find angle C.
questions.explanation: The angles of a triangle sum to 180: angle C = 180 - 50 - 70 = 60 degrees.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A central angle of a circle is 80 degrees. Find the inscribed angle standing on the same arc.
questions.explanation: The inscribed angle theorem states an inscribed angle is half the central angle subtending the same arc: 80/2 = 40 degrees.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the number of sides of a regular polygon whose each interior angle is 144 degrees.
questions.explanation: Each exterior angle = 180 - 144 = 36 degrees. Number of sides = 360/36 = 10.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Two similar triangles have corresponding sides in the ratio 2:5. If the shorter triangle's side is 6cm, find the corresponding side of the larger triangle.
questions.explanation: Since the sides are in ratio 2:5, the larger side = 6 x (5/2) = 15 cm.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the value of sin 30 degrees.
questions.explanation: Sin 30 degrees is a standard trigonometric value equal to 1/2.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the value of cos 60 degrees.
questions.explanation: Cos 60 degrees is a standard trigonometric value equal to 1/2.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the value of tan 45 degrees.
questions.explanation: Tan 45 degrees is a standard trigonometric value equal to 1, since sin 45 = cos 45.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: In a right triangle, the opposite side is 3cm and the hypotenuse is 5cm. Find sin theta.
questions.explanation: Sin theta = opposite/hypotenuse = 3/5.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: In a 3-4-5 right triangle, the adjacent side is 4cm and the opposite side is 3cm. Find tan theta.
questions.explanation: Tan theta = opposite/adjacent = 3/4.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Evaluate: sin^2(30) + cos^2(30)
questions.explanation: By the Pythagorean trigonometric identity, sin^2(theta) + cos^2(theta) = 1 for any angle theta.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: If tan theta = 1, and 0 <= theta <= 90 degrees, find theta.
questions.explanation: Tan theta = 1 when theta = 45 degrees, a standard trigonometric value.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A ladder leans against a wall making a 60 degree angle with the ground. The foot of the ladder is 4m from the wall. Find the length of the ladder. (cos 60 = 0.5)
questions.explanation: Cos 60 = adjacent/hypotenuse = 4/length, so length = 4/0.5 = 8 m.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the value of cos 90 degrees.
questions.explanation: Cos 90 degrees is a standard trigonometric value equal to 0.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the value of sin 90 degrees.
questions.explanation: Sin 90 degrees is a standard trigonometric value equal to 1.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the mean of the data set: 4, 8, 6, 10, 12.
questions.explanation: Mean = sum of values / number of values = (4+8+6+10+12)/5 = 40/5 = 8.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the range of the data set: 12, 7, 15, 3, 9.
questions.explanation: Range = highest value - lowest value = 15 - 3 = 12.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A fair die is thrown once. Find the probability of getting an even number.
questions.explanation: Even numbers on a die are 2, 4, 6 (3 outcomes) out of 6 possible outcomes, giving a probability of 3/6 = 1/2.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A bag contains 4 red balls and 6 blue balls. Find the probability of picking a red ball at random.
questions.explanation: Total balls = 4 + 6 = 10. Probability of red = 4/10 = 2/5.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the mode of the data set: 3, 5, 5, 7, 9, 5, 2.
questions.explanation: The mode is the most frequently occurring value; 5 appears three times, more than any other value.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Two fair coins are tossed together. Find the probability of getting two heads.
questions.explanation: Possible outcomes are HH, HT, TH, TT (4 total), of which only HH gives two heads, so the probability is 1/4.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the mean of the first 5 even numbers: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A card is drawn at random from a standard deck of 52 playing cards. Find the probability that it is a king.
questions.explanation: There are 4 kings in a deck of 52 cards, so the probability is 4/52 = 1/13.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the median of the data set: 8, 3, 10, 15, 6, 7.
questions.explanation: Arranged in order: 3,6,7,8,10,15. With 6 values, the median is the average of the two middle values: (7+8)/2 = 7.5.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: In a class of 40 students, 25 offer Physics. Find the probability that a randomly selected student offers Physics.
questions.explanation: Probability = 25/40, which simplifies (dividing by 5) to 5/8.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A man's age is 4 times his son's age. In 5 years, he will be 3 times his son's age. Find the son's present age.
questions.explanation: Let the son's age be x, so the man's age is 4x. In 5 years: 4x+5 = 3(x+5), giving 4x+5 = 3x+15, so x = 10.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: The sum of three consecutive integers is 72. Find the largest integer.
questions.explanation: Let the integers be n, n+1, n+2. Then 3n+3 = 72, so n = 23, making the largest integer 23+2 = 25.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A trader buys a bag of rice for N18,000 and sells it for N21,600. Find the percentage profit.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: N5,000 is to be divided between A and B in the ratio 3:2. Find A's share.
questions.explanation: Total parts = 3+2 = 5. A's share = (3/5) x 5,000 = N3,000.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A car bought for N2,000,000 depreciates by 10% in its first year. Find its value after one year.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: The perimeter of a rectangular field is 90m and its length is 25m. Find its width.
questions.explanation: Perimeter = 2(length + width): 90 = 2(25 + width), so 45 = 25 + width, giving width = 20 m.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find two numbers whose sum is 30 and whose difference is 8.
questions.explanation: Let the numbers be x and y: x+y=30 and x-y=8. Adding gives 2x=38, so x=19 and y=11.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A worker is paid N450 per hour. Find his earnings for a 40-hour work week.
questions.explanation: Earnings = 450 x 40 = N18,000.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: If 8 workers can complete a job in 15 days, how many days will it take 12 workers to complete the same job at the same rate?
questions.explanation: Using inverse proportion: 8 x 15 = 12 x d, so d = 120/12 = 10 days.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A pipe can fill a cistern in 6 hours. What fraction of the cistern is filled in 2 hours?
questions.explanation: Fraction filled = 2/6 = 1/3.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: The price of an item increased from N2,500 to N3,000. Find the percentage increase.
questions.explanation: Increase = 3,000 - 2,500 = 500. Percentage increase = (500/2,500) x 100 = 20%.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A man invests N50,000 at 8% simple interest per annum. Find the interest after 3 years.
questions.explanation: Simple interest = (P x R x T)/100 = (50,000 x 8 x 3)/100 = N12,000.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Three friends share a profit of N24,000 in the ratio 2:3:5. Find the largest share.
questions.explanation: Total parts = 2+3+5 = 10. Largest share = (5/10) x 24,000 = N12,000.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A train travels 300km at an average speed of 75km/h. Find the time taken.
questions.explanation: Time = distance/speed = 300/75 = 4 hours.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: The population of a town increased from 40,000 to 46,000 in one year. Find the percentage increase.
